name: Barmer

queries.query: Barmer Rajasthan official cadastral parcel map Bhu Naksha Rajdharaa
queries.result: First-party discovery identified Rajasthan Government Bhu-Naksha, the Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal, the Rajasthan cadastral-map digitization program, and the official Barmer district portal. The Urban GIS page exposes Khasra search and map/info actions, but no anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry response was exposed in bounded inspection.

queries.query: बाड़मेर राजस्थान आधिकारिक भू नक्शा खसरा मानचित्र सरकारी
queries.result: First-party Hindi discovery identified Rajasthan Revenue Board/Apna Khata, the Rajasthan Government cadastral-map digitization pages, Bhu-Naksha, and the Barmer district government portal. The official Apna Khata page links भू नक्शा and describes Rajasthan land-record services; no safe anonymous parcel geometry endpoint was exposed.

freshResearch.method: Separate English and Hindi first-party discovery, followed by bounded TLS-verified GET/page inspection. No credentials, private tokens, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe-field request, or TLS disablement was used.

portalsFound.observation: Official Rajasthan Urban GIS Portal. The rendered page exposes Khasra Search, View On Map, View Khasra Info, district/tehsil/village selectors, and states that khasra and village boundaries come from the Settlement Department, Rajasthan. It is a public viewing portal, but the bounded page did not expose a safe parcel feature schema, CRS, or geometry response for Barmer.

Official Rajasthan Bhu-Naksha cadastral-mapping entry. Discovery describes plot info and map layers and attributes data to the respective State Government and Department of Land Resources; the page was unavailable during the bounded fetch, so no live service configuration or parcel response was harvested.

Official Rajasthan Revenue Board Apna Khata page. It identifies the state revenue custodian, links भू नक्शा, and documents public land-record access and its non-certified informational limitation; it does not itself expose a safe parcel geometry response.
Official Rajasthan Board of Revenue cadastral-map digitization page, evidencing state cadastral-map program custody but not a queryable Barmer parcel API.
Official Barmer district portal was identified as a local government entry point; no parcel viewer or geometry service was exposed in the bounded discovery result.

requests.assessment: TLS-verified web inspection returned 502 Bad Gateway; no retry with verification disabled and no API/configuration was harvested.

Rendered public portal page confirmed Khasra and map/info controls and Settlement Department boundary provenance. No bounded anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, schema, CRS, or Barmer-specific selection result was obtained.

Official E-Mapping page loaded and exposed district/SR/village/locality and selected-khasra controls. It is a DLC information viewer; no parcel geometry or safe ID response was obtained, and no owner/rate/account fields were requested.

Official Revenue Board page loaded and exposed district/tehsil/village and भू नक्शा links. No parcel geometry request was made because the page is a general land-record entry and the safe anonymous map endpoint was not established.

Official Government of India map-digitization status route timed out during bounded inspection. This is general national program evidence, not local Barmer registry custody, and no retry or geometry request was made.
Direct request timed out after 20 seconds; this does not establish absence or map coverage.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Rajasthan state cadastral/land-record and public GIS services, with Barmer district government entry point.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: State-level public portal custody and UI evidence only; Barmer-specific anonymous parcel geometry, schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, and citywide completeness were not verified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native parcel ID/khasra identity if independently exposed

geometryDecision.exactWupPointTest: Not performed because no safe anonymous parcel feature endpoint was established; exact point was preserved and never shifted.

remainingUncertainty: The live Bhu-Naksha viewer/API configuration, access controls, source layer schema, CRS, stable native parcel identity, geometry quality, update currency, and Barmer citywide coverage remain unresolved. A timeout, 502, or absent exact-point response would not prove citywide absence. Packet completion records source research only and is not source integration/admission.
